contract.note: The causal reading and cited comparison period are reasonable. Rejecting exact monthly proportionality as the test avoids imposing a stronger claim than either speaker supplied.

reviews.rationale: Neither disclosure establishes or refutes the disputed causal relationship. Matched capacity and revenue data, with pricing, efficiency, utilization and demand distinguished, are absent.

contract.note: Testing an ongoing causal process is faithful. Requiring deception, investor reliance and financial transmission gives ordinary factual content to the allegation.

Pre-statement reporting confirms public indications of improving product margins, including applications. It uses the same survey and supplies no identifiable startup's comparable company margins.

reviews.rationale: The survey challenges the broad narrative, but its anonymous product-level averages do not establish a qualifying company-level counterexample. The packet also cannot establish no improvement across AI startups.
